summary: Three new admin-alert builders (E031-E033) for t-hunted parser are correctly added to admin_alerts.py, matching the lamley E025/E027/E028 shape, severity, Russian copy style, and section structure. Placement (between E028 and E030), function signatures, severity emoji, and unique-codes regression test all align with the task spec, tech-spec Decision 3, and code-research §A.5. Full suite (29 tests) passes; smoke check returns the expected [E031]/[E032]/[E033] prefixes.

suggestions.suggestion: alert_t_hunted_fetch_error omits a 'Что произошло:' preamble and jumps straight from 'Ошибка: {error}' to 'Что сделать:'. This intentionally mirrors E027 (alert_lamley_fetch_error), so it is consistent — but if the operator ever wants a one-line context ('HTTP/сетевая ошибка при загрузке статьи'), adding it would make the alert self-describing without needing to recall the code. Strictly optional; matching E027 is the documented choice.
suggestions.benefit: Marginally improves alert self-containment for on-call triage.

suggestions.suggestion: The three new t-hunted tests (E031-E033) are inserted between test_e028_lamley_no_body and test_e030_orangetrack_summary_header, producing non-ascending numeric order in the test file (028 -> 031 -> 032 -> 033 -> 030). This exactly matches the source-file ordering rationale (E030 is an outlier aggregator that stays last) and was explicitly required by the task spec, so no change is needed — but a one-line section comment ('# E030 lives below the t-hunted block — see admin_alerts.py ordering note') would prevent future contributors from 'fixing' the order.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents accidental reordering by future contributors who might assume strict numeric ascending order.
